repos_data.description: Code-aware browser testing for AI coding agents. 14 MCP tools, CLI workflows, regression memory, and human-readable QA reports.
A framework for speeding up the development of automated UI tests for Windows, Android, iOS, and Web with Appium/Selenium on .NET

repo_meta_data.description: Open-source test automation for Android, iOS, web, smart TV (Android TV, Tizen, webOS) and Bluetooth (BLE) devices. Write tests as CSV/YAML, record them live, or let an AI agent build them over MCP. Self-healing locators: XPath, text, OCR, image.
